items.title: PS5 Pro is Sold Out Everywhere as GTA VI Pre-Load Starts Next Week
items.summary: The PS5 Pro is sold out at major US retailers as GTA 6 pre-downloads open Nov. 10 with a 212GB storage need, while Sony stock slipped Friday.

items.title: Best Buy’s Dividend Is Barely Growing. Should Income Investors Be Worried?
items.summary: Best Buy once boosted its payout by more than 25% a year. Now the raises barely register, a new CEO is spending on other priorities, and the next dividend declaration could reveal where income investors rank.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Equal Weight (GSEW) Adds HF Sinclair and Rubrik on Nov. 4
items.summary: The $2.26 billion ETF bought $354.9 million of stock, added five new positions and exited five others.

items.title: Best Buy Store Rollout Could Change The Case For Zip Co (ASX:ZIP)
items.summary: Zip Co announced that its partnership with Best Buy has expanded nationwide into physical stores, allowing eligible shoppers to use Zip’s tap to pay app at the register alongside existing online options. The rollout into Best Buy locations comes as Zip reports in-store purchases at 30% of U.S. transaction volume and 61% year over year growth in U.S. in-store transaction volume in First Quarter Fiscal Year 27, highlighting the growing role of physical retail in its payments mix. items.title: Wayfair Q3 Earnings Beat on U.S. Growth and Ad Cost Leverage
items.summary: W's Q3 earnings beat draws on 11.4% U.S. sales growth and improved advertising leverage, but its Q4 outlook calls for heavier holiday ad spending.

items.title: Booking Holdings Q3 Earnings Beat on Travel Growth, Revenues Miss
items.summary: BKNG's Q3 earnings beat estimates as room nights and gross bookings climb, but an FTC-related revenue hit leads to a sales miss as Q4 growth is set to slow.

items.title: Uber Inks Deal With Key Food Stores: More Upside Ahead?
items.summary: Uber's partnership with Key Food brings grocery delivery to more than 300 stores across the Northeast and Florida, boosting its grocery delivery presence.

items.title: Coty upgrades warehouse lighting to slash emissions
items.summary: As part of its sustainability strategy, Coty swapped out nearly 2,600 fixtures in a Maryland facility, cutting lighting-related energy consumption by 25%.
